goal: Create the Week 1 RPA workflow and place the Streamlit registration page inside an application/browser scope.
procedure: Open UiPath Studio Web and choose Create New → RPA Workflow
Rename Solution to User Interface Automation
Open https://uipath-registration-app.streamlit.app/ in another browser tab
Install the UiPath Studio Web Automation Extension if prompted
Add Use Application/Browser and choose Streamlit under Work in scope
expected_result: The workflow contains a browser application scope connected to the Streamlit page.
known_failures: Streamlit is not available in Work in scope
diagnostic_checks: Confirm the Streamlit URL is open in another tab
Confirm the Studio Web Automation Extension is installed

goal: Enter the username using a Type Into activity with the indicated field and its stable anchor.
procedure: Add a Type Into activity inside the Streamlit application scope
Click Indicate Target and select the User name field
Confirm the green target selection and blue anchor selection
Enter any username in the Type this field
expected_result: The username is entered into the correct Streamlit field using the target and anchor.
trigger_symptom: text goes into the wrong field
diagnostic_checks: Check that the green target and blue anchor are both present
Re-indicate the User name field if the selector changed

goal: Complete the Streamlit login with username, password and the two-click Submit sequence specified in the exercise.
procedure: Add another Type Into activity targeting the password field
Enter AgenticAndRobotic as the password
Add a Click activity targeting Submit
Add a second consecutive Click activity targeting the same Submit button
Go to the Streamlit tab and log in
expected_result: The login completes and the Conference participants page appears.
known_failures: Only one Submit click is configured
Password is typed into the wrong field
diagnostic_checks: Confirm the password value and target
Confirm two consecutive Click activities target Submit

goal: Extract the conference participant table from all pages into a named DataTable variable.
procedure: After logging in, add Extract Table Data
Indicate the first name field on the Conference participants page
Choose Yes when prompted
Enable Extract data from multiple pages
Move the table popup to expose the next button, indicate next and choose Save & Close
Replace the generated destination variable with a descriptive variable such as ExtractedDataTable
expected_result: Participant rows from multiple pages are stored in a reusable DataTable variable.
known_failures: Only the first page is extracted
Generated destination variable is not replaced
diagnostic_checks: Check Extract data from multiple pages is enabled
Check the destination variable contains the extracted table

goal: Loop through the extracted DataTable and submit each participant to the Conference Contact Form.
procedure: Open a new Use Application/Browser activity for the Conference Contact Form
Add For Each Row in Data Table and select ExtractedDataTable
Keep the item name as CurrentRow
Add Fill Form and choose CurrentRow as the Data Source
Add a Click activity targeting Submit inside the loop
Repeat the submission steps for every DataTable row
activity_names: For Each Row in Data Table
expected_result: Every extracted participant row is mapped to the matching form fields and submitted.
known_failures: Fill Form is outside the loop
Submit click is outside the loop
diagnostic_checks: Check ExtractedDataTable is selected
Check Fill Form and Submit are inside For Each Row in Data Table
Check CurrentRow is the data source

goal: Create a Data Validation workflow that reads account details row by row from Google Sheets.
procedure: Create a new RPA Workflow and rename Solution to Data Validation
Add For Each Row in Spreadsheet (Google Workspace)
Browse to and select the account-details spreadsheet
Select the required sheet range
Confirm the range and header configuration
expected_result: The workflow iterates through each account row and exposes its fields for validation.
known_failures: Header configuration does not match the sheet
diagnostic_checks: Check Google Sheets connection, spreadsheet and range
Check whether the selected range contains headers

goal: Use Regex.IsMatch to validate the Email field against the exercise email pattern.
procedure: Add an If activity inside the spreadsheet row loop
Open the condition builder and expression editor
Enter System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(Email, "^[\w\.]+@\w+\.\w+$")
Save the expression
Change the expression result comparison to is true
expected_result: The email condition evaluates true only when the value matches the configured pattern.
known_failures: Expression is not changed to is true
trigger_symptom: condition builder shows a type mismatch
diagnostic_checks: Check ^ and $ anchors
Check the escaped dot \.
Check Regex.IsMatch is compared with is true

goal: Require both a valid email and a non-empty First name before marking a row as passed.
procedure: Add a second condition to the If activity
Choose First name and set it to is not empty text
Keep the operator as AND
Add Set Variable Value in the Then branch and create status_value as Text
Set status_value to Passed in Then and Failed in Else
expected_result: A row is Passed only when both conditions are true; otherwise it is Failed.
known_failures: OR is used instead of AND
status_value is not created as Text
Only one branch sets the status
trigger_symptom: invalid emails pass when a name exists
diagnostic_checks: Check the operator is AND
Check both Then and Else assign status_value
Check the variable type is Text

goal: Write the Passed/Failed status into the correct physical spreadsheet row.
procedure: Place Write Cell outside the If block but inside For Each Row in Spreadsheet
Use the Status column as the target column
Build the cell expression with the CurrentRowIndex + 2 offset
Write status_value to the cell
Run Debug on Cloud and inspect the spreadsheet
expected_result: Each data row receives its status without overwriting the header row.
known_failures: Write Cell is inside only one If branch
DataTable is changed but the sheet is not written
trigger_symptom: status is written to the wrong row
diagnostic_checks: Check Write Cell nesting
Check the +2 physical row offset
Check the target spreadsheet and Status column

goal: Test the validation pattern with positive and negative examples before relying on it in the workflow.
procedure: Test complete-string matching with ^ and $
Check that a literal dot is written as \.
Try valid and invalid email examples
Compare the expression with the intended data format
Use the same tested expression in the If activity
expected_result: The workflow accepts only values with the intended complete format.
known_failures: A bare dot matches any character
The simplified course pattern is assumed to support every legal email
trigger_symptom: substring passes as a full value
diagnostic_checks: Read the pattern left to right
Test representative edge cases
Compare the pattern with the exercise requirement

goal: Prepare the Week 3 PDF input folder and output spreadsheet before building the extraction workflow.
procedure: Copy the input data folder to your own Google Drive
Copy the output Google spreadsheet to your own Google Drive
Create a new RPA Workflow
Rename Solution to Document Data Extraction
expected_result: The workflow and both Google Drive resources are available under the student's account.
diagnostic_checks: Confirm both resources exist in the student's Drive
Confirm the workflow name is Document Data Extraction

goal: Loop through PDF files and extract invoice data with the UiPath Invoices model.
procedure: Add For Each File or Folder (Google Workspace)
Select the folder containing the input files
Add the filter Type is PDF
Add Extract Document Data
Set Input to CurrentItem
Set Document Understanding project to Predefined
Set Extractor to Invoices
expected_result: Every PDF produces a Document Data output containing invoice fields and line items.
diagnostic_checks: Check the Type is PDF filter
Check Input=CurrentItem
Check Project=Predefined and Extractor=Invoices

goal: Write invoice header values and every line item to the correct cells in the Individual sheet.
procedure: Add Write Cell activities for VendorName at A1, InvoiceNumber at B1 and InvoiceDate at C1
Use documentData.Data.Items in an inner For Each activity
Create Number variable CurrentRowNumber with default value 0
Assign CurrentRowNumber = Index + 1 inside the item loop
Write Description, Quantity, UnitPrice and LineAmount to columns D:G using CurrentRowNumber
expected_result: Header values are written once and each line item occupies its own spreadsheet row.
known_failures: Line items use one fixed cell
Header fields are not written to row 1
diagnostic_checks: Check the inner For Each iterates documentData.Data.Items
Check CurrentRowNumber is assigned inside the loop
Check D:G cell expressions

goal: Prevent one invoice from overwriting another by appending the Individual sheet into Overall.
procedure: Run the initial workflow and observe the overwrite behavior
Add Read Range for the Individual sheet or ExtractedValue range with Has Header=False
Add Write Range targeting Overall
Set How to write to Append
Add Delete Range for Individual with Delete behavior set to Clear
Run Debug on Cloud again
expected_result: Overall grows after every PDF and Individual is cleared before the next PDF.
known_failures: Rows are duplicated because Individual is not cleared
diagnostic_checks: Check Read Range reads Individual
Check Write Range uses Append
Check Delete Range clears Individual after append

goal: Verify that the final spreadsheet contains all invoice records after the multi-PDF workflow completes.
procedure: Run Debug on Cloud after adding the append and clear steps
Open the Overall sheet
Confirm records from each input PDF are present
Confirm the Individual sheet is empty or ready for the next PDF
expected_result: The Overall sheet contains accumulated invoice data and no invoice has been lost or duplicated.
known_failures: Individual still contains the prior invoice
diagnostic_checks: Compare Overall with the number of input PDFs
Inspect the final Individual sheet state

goal: Prepare the customer_emails and appointments Google Sheets used by the appointment agent tutorial.
procedure: Create a Google Sheet named customer_emails and copy the supplied email data
Ensure customer_emails contains email address, subject and email body fields
Create a Google Sheet named appointments and copy the supplied appointment data
Ensure appointments contains customer Name and appointment DateTime fields
Create the Appointment Reply Workflow and add For Each Row in Spreadsheet for customer_emails
expected_result: The workflow can read incoming customer emails and the appointment tool can read appointment records.
diagnostic_checks: Check sheet names and required columns
Check the Google Sheets connection and Has headers setting

goal: Create the Agent project, define its input/output variables, and bind the customer email values into the prompts.
procedure: Add an Agent project to the Appointment Scheduler Agent Solution
Choose Start fresh
Paste the supplied system prompt
Create String inputs EmailAddress and EmailBody
Create String output EmailReply
Paste the supplied user prompt and replace placeholders with input.EmailBody and input.EmailAddress
expected_result: The Agent receives the current email body and address and returns an EmailReply string.
known_failures: EmailAddress or EmailBody is not declared
User prompt placeholders are not mapped to inputs
diagnostic_checks: Check the Agent Data Manager inputs and outputs
Check user prompt references input.EmailBody and input.EmailAddress

goal: Build the RPA workflow that looks up, changes or cancels an appointment and returns a result.
procedure: Add an RPA workflow named Appointment Check Workflow
Add For Each Row in Spreadsheet for the appointments sheet
Create Text arguments In_CustomerDate, In_CustomerName, In_CustomerRequest and Out_ProcessReturn
Match CurrentRow.Name to In_CustomerName with an If
Add a Switch on In_CustomerRequest with Check, Change and Cancel children
For Check, assign the appointment date to Out_ProcessReturn
For Change, write In_CustomerDate to column B using CurrentRowIndex+2 and return Appointment Change
For Cancel, delete the matching row using CurrentRowIndex+1 and return Appointment Cancelled
expected_result: The matching appointment is checked, updated or removed and the tool returns a descriptive result.
known_failures: Delete Rows targets the wrong row
diagnostic_checks: Check all four arguments in Data Manager
Check Change uses B & CurrentRowIndex + 2
Check Cancel uses CurrentRowIndex + 1

goal: Return Appointment not found only after the appointment loop has checked every row without a match.
procedure: Place an If activity outside the appointments For Each Row loop
Test whether Out_ProcessReturn is empty text
Inside the Then branch, assign Appointment not found to Out_ProcessReturn
Add Log Message using Out_ProcessReturn with Info log level
expected_result: A missing appointment produces Appointment not found after the complete search, and the result is logged.
known_failures: Not-found result is assigned inside the loop
Out_ProcessReturn is overwritten after a match
trigger_symptom: valid appointment is reported as not found
diagnostic_checks: Check the second If is outside the loop
Check it tests Out_ProcessReturn is empty
Check the Info log contains Out_ProcessReturn

goal: Connect the Appointment Check Workflow as an Agent tool and send the generated reply from the fixed RPA workflow.
procedure: Add Appointment Check Workflow as a new RPA workflow tool in the Agent
Return to Appointment Reply Workflow
Add Run Job inside the customer_emails row loop and select the Agent process
Map EmailBody to CurrentRow.Body and EmailAddress to CurrentRow.From
Clear Entry point path as the documented workaround
Add Send Email (Google Workspace)
Set Save as Draft to False and use EmailReply as the email body
Build the subject as RE: plus CurrentRow.Subject
expected_result: Each customer email is interpreted by the Agent, the appointment tool is called when needed, and a reply is sent.
known_failures: Entry point path causes an agent error
Run Job inputs are mapped to the wrong CurrentRow fields
EmailReply is not used as the body
diagnostic_checks: Clear Entry point path
Check Body and From mappings
Check Send Email connection, recipient, subject and EmailReply body
